title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Card Debit Buffer — Desk Guidance Note
content:
A card debit buffer stays on a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account when an instant cashout onto the Everyday Pay Card is worked out: an account with 2 or more earnings debits in the last 3 months leaves the largest earnings debit ever booked on the account; one with exactly 1 leaves a fixed 10.00; and one with none leaves nothing.

## Terms

- **Earnings debit** — an entry on the payout account by which a batch tip reduction or a batch pay reversal is taken from the unpaid earnings balance.
- **The last 3 months** — the earnings debits booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the cashout.
- **The largest earnings debit ever booked on the account** — the single largest earnings debit in the account's whole history, whether or not it falls within the last 3 months.

## Input, judgement, result

| Input: earnings debits in the last 3 months | Judgement | Buffer left on the account |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | the count reaches 2 | the amount of the largest earnings debit ever booked on the account |
| exactly 1 | the count is 1 | a fixed 10.00 |
| 0 | no earnings debit in the window | nothing |

The count in the last 3 months decides the row; only the 2-or-more row reads the account's whole debit history to find the amount.

## Hypothetical cases

- An account with earnings debits of 6.00 and 14.50 inside the last 3 months and an older debit of 32.00 booked a year earlier: the count is 2, so the buffer is 32.00, the largest earnings debit ever booked.
- An account with a single earnings debit of 48.00 in the last 3 months: the count is 1, so the buffer is a fixed 10.00, not 48.00.
- An account whose only earnings debits were booked 3 whole months or more before the day of the cashout: the count is 0, so no buffer stays.
